ethicsDisclaimer: Good Dog offers general reward-based training education. It is not veterinary care, clinical behaviour treatment, or a substitute for hands-on professional assessment.

referrals.title: Contact your vet first
referrals.body: Sudden behaviour change, pain, illness, or loss of appetite needs a medical check before training plans change.

referrals.title: Find ABTC-registered help
referrals.body: For ongoing aggression, severe fear, or clinical behaviour needs, use an ABTC-registered Clinical Animal Behaviourist or Veterinary Behaviourist.

referrals.title: Reward-based training standards
referrals.body: Choose trainers aligned with force-free, science-based methods — avoid pain, fear, and coercion as routine solutions.
